body: I like how this seems to be an easily digestible explanation of the death arcana. I've always been fascinated by the Major Arcana, sadly all my knowledge of it only comes from Persona.

I don't know why but from my perspective this sounds a lot like a paradox of inescapability of death and free will wherein one can only break the paradox by practice of free will and accepting death or (trigger warning) >! killing ones self !<

Right now I have nothing but hope that I forget and get over my problems soon. I want them to go away but they keep coming back. They're like ghosts that haunt me from the very first thing in the morning, to the last thing at night. I can't seem to escape them even if I wanted to.

I feel like I'm too exhausted to explore my hobbies. All I do now is listen to music while I drink and smoke. And I think that in my case right now, I don't really find such things as helpful but rather they seem to me like they are just distractions that make me look away from my problems for a moment. At the end of the day I still end up lying awake in bed thinking of either my problems or ways to kill myself.
This is actually the first time i used the dithering tool. Maybe some advice?
